case_number: CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 1294 OF 2023; CRIMINAL APPEAL NO. 1295 OF 2023

parties.respondent: The State of Uttar Pradesh & Ors

summary: Illegal transfer of investigation to CBCID; scope of further investigation post-chargesheeting; Sections 173(8) & 158 Cr.P.C. interpretation; Magistrate's prior approval for reinvestigation mandatory; quashing petition rejection precedent; accused's defense impermissibly considered pre-trial; no leave from Magistrate before transfer; High Court failed to examine post-chargesheet investigation validity; transfer order quashed.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; order directing CBCID investigation quashed; High Court judgment set aside.
